title: Collective Punishment for Inaction
summary: If a community tolerates sins without reform, all may face punishment.
translation: The Prophet Muhammad (peace be upon him) said that Allah does not punish the majority of a community for the sins of a few. That is, if some members are involved in wrongdoings, sins, and disobedience to Allah's commands, others are not punished on their account. However, if people see that some individuals are committing unlawful acts and do not attempt to reform or stop them, although they have the ability to do so, and they are content with the situation as it is, then more of the community may be afflicted with punishment. In such a case, Allah's punishment can encompass both the general and specific people, not just those committing the sins, but also those who remain silent about the wrongdoing.
